summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of Prochem Tapasya single-page marketing home. All 12 requested flows verified end-to-end on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Navbar, hero kinetic headline + CTA, all 5 desktop nav links, Enquire CTA, animated stats counters, 7 interactive capability items with image reveal, 12-card Products bento grid with fully loaded Unsplash images, editorial marquee, global regions list, footer/contact (mailto + tel + footer nav), and the mobile hamburger + mobile menu with smooth scroll — all working. Lenis smooth scroll lands each section exactly at target - 80px offset (diff=0px in every case) once a sufficient wait (~3.5s) is used to let the momentum finish. Zero console errors on load and after interactions. No broken images.

issues: Words INTEGRATED / PROCESS / SOLUTIONS render without space in DOM textContent ('INTEGRATEDPROCESSSOLUTIONS.') due to overflow-hidden line wrappers. Visually stacked correctly but may hurt SEO/accessibility. Consider adding aria-label='Integrated Process Solutions' to the h1 or using visually-hidden separators.

action_items: Optional: add aria-label on hero h1 so assistive tech reads 'Integrated Process Solutions' (currently textContent concatenates the three lines).
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx line rendering: LINES[i==2] branch outputs 'SOLUTIONS' text but the loop key is `line` (still 'SOLUTIONS') — fine, but the conditional could be simplified.
useLenis exposes lenis via window.__lenis global — acceptable for a static site but note it is a global side-effect; prefer context if the app grows.
Products.jsx and Capabilities.jsx correctly reference IMAGES map keys; no null lookups possible with current data.
All interactive elements carry data-testid as required — good testability.
No backend usage on this page as intended; site-data is fully static.
Image loading uses `loading="lazy"` on product cards but Unsplash returns 200 for all six IMAGES entries — verified 0 broken images across the entire page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lenis smooth scroll takes up to ~3s for long jumps (e.g., top -> #global at ~7000px). Use wait_for_timeout of at least 3000ms before asserting scrollY, or poll until window.__lenis.isScrolling is false. Data-testids: site-navbar, nav-logo, nav-{about,capabilities,products,global,contact}, nav-cta, nav-mobile-toggle, mobile-menu, mobile-nav-{...}, hero-cta, stats-band, capabilities-section, capability-0..6, products-section, product-card-0..11, marquee-section, global-section, contact-section, contact-email-cta, contact-phone, footer-nav-{about,capabilities,products,global}, about-section, home-page. All confirmed present.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional issues found. Initial 'nav-global not aligned' failure during first pass was purely a test-timing issue (1.8s wait insufficient for Lenis to complete a ~4500px scroll). Increasing wait to 3.5s produced diff=0px.
